summary.text: Colton Bennett is the Republican candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 6A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Trish Carter-Goodheart.
Bennett is a U.S. Army veteran and EMT.

paragraphs.text: Colton Bennett was born in Indianapolis, Indiana, and earned an associate degree from Purdue University Global in 2021.
Ballotpedia lists his military service as the U.S. Army and his profession as EMT.
Bennett ran for the Republican nomination in Idaho House District 6A in 2024, finishing second to incumbent Lori McCann in the May 21 primary, 40.5 percent to 43.6 percent.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Christian, conservative, husband, father and U.S. Army veteran, and listed reducing property taxes, protecting unborn life and protecting Idaho's dams among his key messages.
